evidence.decision: Matches inline guidance, contextual tip and tutorial to task complexity while checking whether the control itself should be repaired.
evidence.artifact: Delivers exact help copy/anchor/eligibility/dismissal/later-access behavior rather than ungrounded usability claims.
evidence.transformation: Spreadsheet repeated generic tip and oversized tooltip become a first-relevant-use import tip, short action tag and separate workflow tutorial.
evidence.verification: Exercises experienced, dismissed, wrong-context and localized states; repeated dismissed help, wrong input wording or no close route fails.
evidence.applicability: Qualifies Mac/visionOS tooltip scope and treats the source’s daily cadence example as illustrative, not a universal rule.
evidence.handoffs: Onboarding handles initial learning and Buttons handles an unclear control when those causes apply.
evidence.distinctiveness: Event eligibility, tooltip scope and task-sized instructional surfaces distinguish this help procedure from generic copy editing.
